assets.label: Robe de la Seconde Ombre
assets.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: complete production character sprite for Project RL, a grimdark futuristic/cyberpunk roguelike with native 64px cells. Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, the existing outfit: retain its identity, material colors, clothing layout, human proportions, stance and full face covering. Input image 2 is ONLY the already accepted finish reference Bastion; do not copy its outfit or body. Give the target the same matte worn game painting, broad readable shadow planes, believable fabric folds and material volumes, controlled irregular dark contours, restrained highlights and locally placed wear. No shiny plastic, sterile vector/cel shading, thick uniform outlines, noisy microdetail or new armor. Readable at about 60 game pixels tall. Same slightly elevated frontal standing view as the target and reference, not isometric. Neutral diffuse overhead light. Whole figure from top of head to soles, all limbs complete, generous margins, TRUE TRANSPARENT background. No scene, ground, cast shadow, words, frame, glow or effects. Feet slightly apart; empty gloved fists slightly out to the sides at waist level, bent elbows, ready for separate weapon attachments. No weapon, exposed face or new accessory. Second Shadow robe: a worn deep crimson hooded long robe with split tails and a dark charcoal central front panel, dark crimson sleeves, narrow grey/charcoal opaque face mask completely concealed under the red hood, black gloves and boots peeking from the long hem. Preserve the red robe, its full-length split silhouette, the dark vertical inner panel and dark covered face. It is not the Arcanist's ivory face mask. Cloth, no added metal plate armor, ornaments, magical glow or mutations.
